# External Reviews

Store external expert reviewer notes here.

Suggested naming:

- `YYYY-MM-DD-expert-01.md`
- `YYYY-MM-DD-expert-02.md`

Suggested structure per file:

- Status: received / addressed / closed
- Reviewer (name or pseudonym)
- Date
- Scope (which version / URL / commit)
- Major issues
- Minor issues
- Actionable items
